title: Certify cheaper physical control routes for all selected P104 scalars
body:
The selected P104 scalar layer now has cheaper literal three-tape routes for all 43 width-64 templates. A two-bit finite-control cache retains unchanged controls across gates. Every unit move, control read, false-control target write, final scratch clear and head return is charged.

The complete source-weighted local bill falls from 153,820,224 to 117,253,520 operations per complex coordinate: **36,566,704 fewer operations**, with all 15,227,252 target writes retained. Multiply by payload dimension D when the local ribbons are supplied. The implementation uses one clean carry and two finite-control bits. The separate 7,936 bit-reset requests remain unimplemented.

All 83,619 reachable layer states, feasible potentials and attaining paths certify the exact minimum in the stated no-prefetch two-bit cache policy. This is not an optimum over arbitrary circuits, physical compilers or weighted tariffs. An independent symbolic route checker proves that controls are current and cleanup is legal. All 473 paired physical fixtures match the unchanged PR3241 compiler and a direct Boolean oracle; aligned fixtures also match rational arithmetic. Six corruption controls pass.

CPython 3.12.14 registered normal/optimized replay, committed bytes/modes, official export and read-only Git-free/empty-PATH normal/optimized replay pass at `8bbb2643b9438a6050404fb2faf39b7390bce321`. Hosted CI is pending. The optional full-history preflight was not run in this shallow checkout. Exact PR6511 circuit bytes are included and bound by ORIGINS.json; no pending checkout is needed.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-cached-control-routes`.

Both operand ribbons must already be available at their local origins. Global owner acquisition, coordinate dispatch, native children, actual reset, all-size controller and outer admission remain open. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

[Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5600#discussioncomment-19364256). Canonical main, revision 8 and live overlap were refreshed before submission. Credit Sagar Thakrar / thakrarsagar / PR3241 for the metered tape model, Nick Petalas / PR3152/3159, PR6511's emitted circuits, DreamingOfClouds / PR6030 and the retained native/compiler lineage. Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0.
